summary: Oscar Piastri won the Dutch Grand Prix from pole position, 1.3s ahead of Max Verstappen, with Isack Hadjar completing the podium.
Oliver Bearman made the biggest climb, from P20 to P6.
Lando Norris had a day to forget, dropping from P2 to P18.
The race was neutralised by 3 safety cars and 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised SAI (10 second time penalty), ANT (10 second time penalty) and ANT (5 second time penalty).
There were 40 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Oscar Piastri leads the championship by 34 points over Lando Norris.
